40022910.author: पदार्थः
40022910.content: रामो Rama, बहूनि many, अहानि days, एवम् thus, तत् that, गीतम् song, परमम् supreme, शुभम् auspicious, शुश्राव heard, मुनिभिः with sages, सार्धम् together, पार्थिवैः with kings, सह along with, वानरैः monkeys.

40022910.author: Translation
40022910.content: Rama thus heard that supremely auspicious song for many days, accompanied by sages, kings, and monkeys.

40022911.author: पदार्थः
40022911.content: तस्मिन् in that, गीते song, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having recognized, सीतापुत्रौ the sons of Sita, कुशीलवौ Kusha and Lava, तस्याः of that, परिषदः assembly, मध्ये in the midst, रामो Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, दूतान् messengers, शुद्धसमाचारान् of pure conduct, आहूय having called, आत्ममनीषया by his own intention.

40022911.author: Translation
40022911.content: Having recognized Kusha and Lava as Sita's sons through that song, Rama, by his own intention, called messengers of pure conduct and spoke words in the midst of that assembly.

40022912.author: पदार्थः
40022912.content: मद्वचो my words, ब्रूत speak, गच्छध्वम् go, इतः from here, भगवतः of the revered one, अन्तिकम् to the presence.

40022912.author: Translation
40022912.content: He instructed them, "Go from here to the presence of the revered one (Valmiki) and speak my words."

40022913.author: पदार्थः
40022913.content: परिषदो of the assembly, मध्ये in the midst, रामः Rama, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke, यदि if, शुद्धसमाचारा of pure conduct, यदि if, वा or, वीतकल्मषा free from sin, करोतु let her perform, इह here, आत्मनः of herself, शुद्धिम् purification, अनुमान्य having obtained permission from, महामुनिम् the great sage.

40022913.author: Translation
40022913.content: In the midst of the assembly, Rama spoke, saying that if Sita is of pure conduct or free from sin, she should perform her purification here, having obtained the great sage's permission.

40022914.author: पदार्थः
40022914.content: छन्दम् the wish, मुनेः of the sage, च and, विज्ञाय having known, सीतायाः of Sita, च and, मनोगतम् the thought in her mind, प्रत्ययम् proof, दातुकामायाः who wishes to give, ततः then, शंसत tell, मे to me, लघु quickly.

40022914.author: Translation
40022914.content: Having understood the wish of the sage and the thought in Sita's mind, who desires to give proof, then quickly report it to me.

40022915.author: पदार्थः
40022915.content: श्वः tomorrow, प्रभाते in the morning, तु indeed, शपथम् an oath, मैथिली Maithili, जनकात्मजा Janaka's daughter, करोतु let her perform, परिषन्मध्ये in the midst of the assembly, शोधनार्थम् for the sake of purification, मम my, एव indeed, च and.

40022915.author: Translation
40022915.content: Let Maithili, Janaka's daughter, perform an oath tomorrow morning in the midst of the assembly for her own purification and indeed for mine.

40022916.author: पदार्थः
40022916.content: श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, राघवस्य of Rama, एतत् this, वचः word, परमम् most, अद्भुतम् wonderful, दूताः messengers, सम्प्रययुः went forth, बाटम् to the hermitage, यत्र where, आस्ते resides, मुनिपुङ्गवः the foremost among sages.

40022916.author: Translation
40022916.content: Having heard this most wonderful speech of Rama, the messengers went forth to the hermitage where the foremost among sages, Valmiki, resided.

40022917.author: पदार्थः
40022917.content: ते they, प्रणम्य having bowed down to, महात्मानम् the great soul, ज्वलन्तम् shining, अमितप्रभम् of immeasurable splendor, ऊचुः they spoke, ते those, रामवाक्यानि Rama's words, मृदूनि soft, मधुराणि sweet, च and.

40022917.author: Translation
40022917.content: Having bowed down to the great soul, who was shining with immeasurable splendor, they spoke Rama's words, which were both soft and sweet.

40022918.author: पदार्थः
40022918.content: तेषां their, तद्व्याहृतं their words, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामस्य of Rama, च and, मनोगतम् his intention, विज्ञाय having understood, सुमहातेजा the greatly effulgent, मुनिः sage, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40022918.author: Translation
40022918.content: Having heard their words and understood Rama's intention, the greatly effulgent sage Valmiki then spoke.

40022919.author: पदार्थः
40022919.content: एवं thus, भवतु let it be, भद्रं good fortune, वः to you, यथा as, वदति speaks, राघवः Rama, तथा so, करिष्यते will do, सीता Sita, दैवतं deity, हि indeed, पतिः husband, स्त्रियाः of a woman.

40022919.author: Translation
40022919.content: Let it be so, good fortune to you, as Rama speaks, so will Sita do, for indeed, a husband is the deity of a woman.

40022920.author: पदार्थः
40022920.content: तथा thus, उक्ताः spoken to, मुनिना by the sage, सर्वे all, राजदूताः royal messengers, प्रत्येत्य having returned, राघवं to Rama, क्षिप्रं quickly, मुनिवाक्यं the sage's words, बभाषिरे spoke, महौजसम् to the greatly powerful one.

40022920.author: Translation
40022920.content: All the royal messengers, thus addressed by the sage, quickly returned to the greatly powerful Rama and conveyed the sage's words.

40022921.author: पदार्थः
40022921.content: ततः then, प्रहृष्टः delighted, काकुत्स्थः Rama, श्रुत्वा having heard, वाक्यं the words, महात्मनः of the great soul, ऋषीन् to the sages, तत्र there, समेतान् assembled, च and, राज्ञः to the kings, च and, एव indeed, अभ्यभाषत addressed.

40022921.author: Translation
40022921.content: Then, greatly delighted after hearing the words of the great soul Valmiki, Rama addressed the sages and kings assembled there.

40022922.author: पदार्थः
40022922.content: भगवन्तः O revered ones, सशिष्याः with disciples, वै indeed, सानुगाः with followers, च and, नराधिपाः O kings, पश्यन्तु let them see, सीताशपथं Sita's oath, यः who, च and, एव indeed, अन्यः other, अपि also, काङ्क्षते desires.

40022922.author: Translation
40022922.content: O revered sages with your disciples, and O kings with your followers, let all who desire witness Sita's oath.

40022923.author: पदार्थः
40022923.content: तस्य his, तत् that, वचनं speech, श्रुत्वा having heard, राघवस्य of Rama, महात्मनः of the great-souled one, सर्वेषाम् of all, ऋषिमुख्यानां of the chief sages, साधुवादो applause, महान् great, अभूत् was.

40022923.author: Translation
40022923.content: Having heard the words of the great-souled Rama, a great acclamation arose from all the chief sages.

40022924.author: पदार्थः
40022924.content: राजानश्च and kings, महात्मानः great-souled ones, प्रशंसन्ति स्म praised, राघवम् Rama, उपपन्नं fitting, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, त्वय्येव in you alone, भुवि on earth, नान्यतः not elsewhere.

40022924.author: Translation
40022924.content: The great-souled kings also praised Rama, saying, "O best among men, this is fitting only in you on earth, and not in anyone else."

40022925.author: पदार्थः
40022925.content: एवं thus, विनिश्चयं decision, कृत्वा having made, श्वोभूत tomorrow, इति thus, राघवः Rama, विसर्जयामास dismissed, तदा then, सर्वान् all, तान् them, शत्रुसूदनः the destroyer of enemies.

40022925.author: Translation
40022925.content: Having thus made the decision for "tomorrow," Rama, the destroyer of enemies, then dismissed all of them.

40022926.author: पदार्थः
40022926.content: इति thus, सम्प्रविचार्य having deliberated well, राजसिंहः the lion among kings, श्वोभूते on the morrow, शपथस्य of the oath, निश्चयं decision, वै indeed, विससर्ज dismissed, मुनीन् the sages, नृपांश्च and the kings, सर्वान् all, स he, महात्मा the great-souled one, महतो great, महानुभावः of great power.

40022926.author: Translation
40022926.content: Having thus deliberated well and made the decision for the oath on the morrow, that great-souled king, the lion among kings and one of great power, dismissed all the sages and kings. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पञ्चनवतितमः सर्ग ।। 95 ।। Thus ends the ninety-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
